description: This file defines the WorkerPool class and related interfaces and classes for managing thread pools, job scheduling, rescheduling, revoking, and monitoring dispatched jobs within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: IWorkerPool
classes.description: Interface for a worker thread pool managing job submission, scheduling, revoking, and snapshotting.

classes.name: WorkerPool
classes.description: Implementation of IWorkerPool managing thread pool, timer, scheduling, and monitoring.

classes.name: WorkerPool::Timer
classes.description: Represents a scheduled timer for deferred job execution within WorkerPool.

classes.name: WorkerPool::Scheduler
classes.description: Schedules jobs using the Timer within WorkerPool.

classes.name: WorkerPool::DispatchedJobMonitor
classes.description: Monitors dispatched jobs for warnings and analysis, active when warning reporting is enabled.

classes.name: WorkerPool::DispatchedJobMonitor::MontiorJob
classes.description: Internal job class for monitoring dispatched jobs.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a job to the thread pool for execution.

methods.name: Reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules a job to run at a specified time.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a scheduled or running job.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Joins the worker threads, waiting for their completion.

methods.name: Snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current worker pool status.

methods.name: WaitForStop
methods.description: Waits for the worker pool to stop within a timeout.
